reviewedFrom: EP08-09 and EP08-11 (docs/enterprise-production/completion-checklist.json) and the EP08 owner decisions of 2026-10-15: approved VPOs leave the budget baseline alone and show as variance against it; approved POs change only through VPOs; the person who reported or verified a completion cannot approve the money step; an org setting (default off) requires a passed inspection before approval, otherwise an audited waiver with a reason. Code: lib/services/{commitment-change-orders,po-completions,purchasing-settings,po-positions,payment-holds}.ts, lib/financials/vpo-approval-thresholds.ts, lib/purchasing/po-position.ts; migration 20261015120000_purchasing_controls. Values are derived from each subcase's inputs and confirmed by the first run on the acceptance stack.

vpo-approval-follows-bands-evidence-and-.derivation: The org's default bands are up to 1,000.00 for vpo.approve and above for vpo.approve_large; evidence is required from 1,000.00 up and always for a back-charge. A purchasing manager raises a 500.00 order (a project lead who holds only vpo.approve approves it), a 1,500.00 order and a -200.00 back-charge. The lead cannot approve or reject the large order or the back-charge (band). A second manager is refused without evidence; the requester is refused as approver (and the refusal is audited once); evidence from another home is refused; with the home's own quote attached the second manager approves both. The budget total is read before and after and does not move.

expected.foreignEvidence: refused: evidence is not the home's

purchasing-controls-cannot-be-forged-thr.derivation: A draft 400.00 order, an approved 300.00 order and a reported completion exist. The requesting manager and a sales agent each try, with their own session, to approve and reprice the draft, reprice the approved order, rewrite its lines, insert an approved VPO, switch off completion verification, retire reasons, verify the completion and mark it billed: all refuse and the rows are unchanged. A sales agent and a manager asking for a band that names commitment.read are refused by the settings service; the manager's valid save succeeds and is audited. The legitimate paths then work: a second manager approves the draft and verifies the completion.

completion-money-step-needs-a-second-per.derivation: Manager A reports the 600.00 walls line; A cannot verify it; B verifies; neither A nor B can approve; C approves and the PO is billed 600.00. The same line cannot be reported again. With the org inspection policy on, the 400.00 roof line (reported by A, verified by B) is refused for C without an inspection or waiver, a two-letter waiver is refused, and a real reason approves it: the waiver is stored on the completion with C's id and written to the audit trail as its own critical entry.

expected.reporterApproves: refused: reporter or verifier cannot approve
expected.verifierApproves: refused: reporter or verifier cannot approve
expected.withoutInspection: refused: needs a passed inspection or waiver
expected.shortWaiver: refused: needs a passed inspection or waiver

waiverRecorded.reason: Roof sheathing inspected with the framing

pay-on-po-completion-reconciles-to-the-b.derivation: A whole-order completion on the 1,000.00 PO is approved and bills 1,000.00. A 150.00 VPO (price increase, below the evidence threshold) is raised and approved afterwards; it cannot ride the billed whole-order completion, so a completion for the VPO alone (no PO lines) is reported, verified and approved and bills 150.00; claiming the VPO again is refused. The position reads original 1,000.00, approved VPOs 150.00, billed 1,150.00, paid 0 and no exception. An off-book 100.00 bill with 120.00 paid then makes the order billed 1,250.00: over the approved 1,150.00 and over the completions' 1,150.00, so the position names overbilled and billed_without_completion, and the Purchasing desk lists the same single row with the same figures.

two-approvals-of-one-completion-bill-onc.derivation: One verified 600.00 completion is approved by two sessions at once. The approval locks the completion, so the second sees it billed and returns the same bill or is refused: one 600.00 bill exists and the completion is billed.
